- CPR Legal Strategy: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Bypassing legislation via judicial nuisance claims.
- Energy Industry Defense: COND (0.2, 0.1) — Defending against preemptive federal overreach.
As the Supreme Court weighs landmark cases like Suncor v. Boulder, legal groups map out consumer-fraud tort angles to keep climate litigation alive.

The Poison:
Weaponizing tort law to govern national energy policy substitutes judicial fiat for representative democracy.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing local consumer fraud pretexts (WHO/WHAT) with broad national economic regulation (WHY).

Social Physics Analysis:
Advocates execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver by packaging systemic regulatory goals into localized tort pretexts to bypass legislative votes.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Force imbalances pull towards tactical co-optation.

The Unavoidable Truth: State nuisance lawsuits seek massive economic damages for global emissions.

The Unavoidable Lie: These legal battles are purely traditional consumer protection cases.
